title: India's twin test: 12.5% US tariff meets CCI's July 31 deadline
content:
USTR's proposed 12.5 per cent textile duty would stack above India's 18 per cent reciprocal tariff, threatening US export competitiveness without an India-specific carve-out. 
CCI must liquidate ~7 million cotton bales by July 31, creating the best mill buying window in over a year. 
July 10 WASDE, July 24 tariff timeline and July 31 CCI deadline compress critical sourcing and export decisions.

title: ICE cotton rallies further on strong demand prospects, weather worries
content:
ICE cotton futures surged 3.82 per cent as stronger demand expectations, adverse US weather, and optimism over US-China agricultural trade lifted buying.
The December contract settled at 81.29 cents per pound, its highest since June 2, with trading volume surging.
Higher crude oil and grain prices also supported cotton, while markets now await USDA export sales and CFTC positioning reports.

title: India's UK apparel orders surge ahead of CETA duty-free trade
content:
UK textile imports from India rose 11.3 per cent YoY to $527.2M in Q1 2026 as buyers advanced orders before CETA's July 15 rollout. 
CETA removes UK apparel duties of up to 12 per cent, eliminating India's tariff disadvantage against Bangladesh. 
Woven apparel exports jumped 23.8 per cent YoY, with origin-rule compliance critical to securing duty-free benefits.

title: World Bank flags slower China growth in 2027, steady export outlook
content:
China’s economy stayed resilient in early 2026, supported by high-tech investment, exports and policy measures.
The World Bank projects growth easing to 4.4 per cent in 2026 and 4.3 per cent in 2027 as domestic demand remains soft.
Exporters and sourcing teams face a steadier export backdrop but should watch property, energy and consumption risks.

title: Vietnam's textile, garment exports up 1.7% YoY in H1 2026
content:
Vietnam's textile and garment exports were estimated at $22.2 billion in H1 2026—up by 1.7 per cent YoY, according to the Vietnam Textile and Apparel Association. 
Exports of fibres, fabrics, accessories and non-woven materials recorded solid growth of between 5.6 per cent and 10.6 per cent during the period.
However, garment exports dropped by 0.4 per cent YoY during the six months amid weak demand.

title: Vietnam's textile & garment exports rise 0.9% to $18.8 bn in H1
content:
Vietnam's textile and garment exports (excluding yarn and fibre) rose 0.9 per cent year-on-year to $18.86 billion in January-June 2026, while yarn exports increased 10.3 per cent to $2.29 billion.
Fabric imports grew 1.7 per cent to $7.67 billion, though cotton imports declined 3.1 per cent in value.
The country is targeting $50 billion in textile, garment, and yarn exports in 2026.

title: ‘FABRIC Cambodia II’ launched with German help amid tougher standards
content:
Germany and Cambodia have launched phase II of a project to improve the latter’s garment, footwear and travel goods sector amid tougher global environmental and labour standards. 
FABRIC Cambodia II focuses on supply-chain transparency and compliance with global regulations, moving beyond factory-floor audits to embed sustainability through public-private policy dialogue and workforce training.
